^x-[A-Za-z0-9].description: Extension settings, kept as written and never read by overbridge. Read one with `overbridge config get x-<name>.<key>`.

branch.description: Branch name template: {id}, {number}, {slug}, {type}. Must use {id} or {number}.

workspace.description: Workspace name template: {id}, {number}, {repo}. Must use {id} or {number}.

branch-types.description: Item type (a Jira issue type or a GitHub label) to the {type} of a branch name; 'default' covers the rest.

issue-type.description: Issue type for new items (Jira). Default: Task.

worklist-scope.description: GitHub only: whose open issues the work list shows. assigned (default): yours; unassigned: nobody's, on a project board; all: both.

worklist-jql.description: Jira only: JQL that narrows the work list to some of your open tickets. Default: (sprint in openSprints() OR statusCategory = "In Progress"). Empty lists every open ticket.

worklist-project.description: GitHub only: a Projects v2 board as <owner>/<number>, or a bare number for the repo's owner. The work list then shows that board's items, not just the issues assigned to you.

worklist-statuses.description: With worklist-project: the board Status values to list, e.g. [Backlog, Ready]. Default: every status except Done.

columns.description: GitHub Projects v2 Status column name to work status. Names not listed fall back to common names (done, in progress, blocked), else todo.

ship-pr.description: Run mob-review inside ship-pr, on the committed branch before it is pushed and the PR is opened. Default true.

ide.description: The editor: the top panel's editor button, and the links agents write for file references. A name, or a mapping with name, link and github.

link.description: Editor link template for a file reference. Placeholders: {path} (absolute), {line}, {relpath}, {owner}, {repo}, {sha}; needs {path} or {relpath}. Default: zed://file{path}:{line} (zed), vscode://file{path}:{line} (vscode), webstorm://open?file={path}&line={line} (webstorm), none for none.

github.description: Add a commit-pinned GitHub permalink ([↗]) after the editor link. Default true.

icebox.description: Settings for `overbridge icebox`. Every key is optional.

prune.description: Repo-relative paths removed by `icebox --prune`, such as node_modules or target. Only paths git ignores and does not track are deleted; no `..`, absolute paths, globs, `.git` or `.claude`.

idle-days.description: Suggest iceboxing a workspace whose claimed PRs are all drafts and whose last activity (commit, PR update or agent state) is older than this many days. The sidebar card shows a hint; nothing is iceboxed automatically. Unset turns the suggestion off.

check-queue.description: How `overbridge check` queues a command. Every key is optional.

max-load-percent.description: Beside a running check, start another only while the 1-minute load average is under this share of the cores; with none running, the first in line always starts. Over 100 allows more load than there are cores. The load average counts threads waiting on disk and locks too, so it is a backstop to max-cpu-percent. Default 300.

max-cpu-percent.description: Beside a running check, start another only while the CPU, measured over the last second, is less busy than this (a run started in the last minute counts as one more busy core). Over 100 turns this gate off. Default 75.

max-parallel.description: Run at most this many commands at once. Unset leaves the load as the only limit; 1 runs them one at a time.

timeout-seconds.description: Kill the run after this long. Default 180.

stall-seconds.description: Kill the run once its processes have used no CPU for this long. Default 300.

wait-seconds.description: Give up waiting for a turn after this long. Default 900.

bin-dirs.description: Repo-relative folders a bare program in a check is looked up in, nearest the current directory first, ahead of the dev shell's PATH. An empty list turns the lookup off. Default ["node_modules/.bin"].

skip-queue-seconds.description: A check whose last passing runs (at least 3 of the exact command) took under this long (the median) starts at once, skipping the queue and the CPU and load gates. 0 queues every check. Default 10.

priority.description: The class this repo's claims get when no priority-rules entry matches: a name from the root config.yml's priority-classes. Default: the class marked default there, else the first.

priority-rules.description: Rules tried in order; the first whose patterns all match a claim or work item sets its class. The check queue and the @work list both use them.

priority.description: A class name from the root config.yml's priority-classes.

branch.description: Regex the claimed branch must match.

item.description: Regex the work item id (from the branch) must match.

type.description: Regex the work item's type must match, such as Jira's Story. Read from the @work list's cache for a claim.

label.description: Regex one of the work item's labels must match. Read from the @work list's cache for a claim.
